targets.query:
SELECT SUM("value") 
FROM (
  SELECT LAST("value") AS "value"
  FROM "sbc_sip_calls_count"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "direction" = 'inbound'
  GROUP BY "host", "instance_id" fill(null)
)

SELECT SUM("value") 
FROM (
  SELECT LAST("value") AS "value"
  FROM "sbc_sip_calls_count"
  WHERE $timeFilter AND "direction" = 'outbound'
  GROUP BY "host", "instance_id" fill(null)
)
